name: Gabie Pilkington Hopper Waits
rel: Second wife of James Clayborn Waits; stepmother to Lovy and Rhoda’s other daughters. Biological mother of Hopper children (not of Lovy).
blurb: Stepmother in Lovy’s household. Buried Memorial Park, Memphis. Find a Grave #116840553.
narrative: Gabie Pilkington married into the Waits household after Rhoda’s death. She is named stepmother in the Linnie Chapman Drive clipping. Her biological children are on the Hopper line (son Eddie Lee Hopper; daughter Lillie May Hopper Ray; Iantha Beasley is a likely further child — keep as hypothesis until locked). Do not list Lovy, Josie Belle, Laura Clemmons, or Katherine Waits as Gabie’s biological Waits children.
